source: Norsk ordbank bokmål 2005 (20220201), Språkbanken / Nasjonalbiblioteket, CC BY 4.0; ranking by FrequencyWords no_50k (OpenSubtitles 2018, CC BY-SA 4.0)
format: lex[i] = "lemma|POS+genders|form,form,..." ordered by estimated frequency (i = rank); the lemma itself is always a form. amb[form] = candidate lexeme indices in preferred order (only where it differs from index order). POS: s=subst v=verb a=adj r=adv p=pron d=det P=prep k=konj S=sbu i=interj f=fork y=symb x=pref I=inf-merke; genders m f n
